main_text.p: riendi ftudium paffim tribuit. Aft, an hoc eft partes nec facere nec fequi ? an non ita in os contradicit Auftralis Hollandiæ Synodis Leerdamenfi & Dordracenæ, Annis poft natum Salvatorem cıo ıo clxxv. & cıo ıo clxxvi. habitis ? Enimverò in nupera Dordracena Synodo cautum eft, ne cuiquam liceat Symmyftas, formulis confenfus adhærentes, traducere tamquam Novatores, idque ne fieret publice aut privatim, nec in concionibus nec in Scriptis, nec in Catechifationibus, nec in precibus vel gratiarum actionibus, nec directe vel indirecte, fpeciali articulo vetitum eft. Poftulabant Fratrum quidam in Actis huic articulo adderetut vocula ᴡeᴅᴇr-ȝɧᴅᴡ / ab utraque parte. Morem ipfis gerebant, qui tamen hanc vocem omiffam maluiffent.

Sequenti mane Illuftr. Ordinum Deputatus ad Synodum, D. Hudde Synodum monebat, voculam hanc partes hinc inde ponere, proindeque expungendam effe omninò ab iis, qui non tantum (ut ex prælectis Claffium votis liquebat) à Schifma-te, fed ab omni ejus fpecie erant alieniffi-mi.

page.notes: The Gothic word in the line "adderetut" is set in black letter, transcribed as a best reading; the black-letter word is uncertain. Ornamental "ᴡeᴅᴇr-ȝɧᴅᴡ" is a doubtful reading of the Gothic vocable (likely "weder-zijds") [?]. Printed "cıo ıo" numerals are the reversed-C forms, transcribed as MDCLXXV and MDCLXXVI in intent but kept as printed here.
